WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 12 AS last_period
),
first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, fv.home_store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, COUNT(*) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 12 AS last_period
),
first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_new_members, COUNT(DISTINCT fv.member_id) AS distinct_members
FROM first_version fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period;

-- Check for any stores that exist but had zero new members
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, COALESCE(nm.new_members, 0) AS new_members
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name, region 
    FROM dim_store 
    WHERE is_current = true
) s
LEFT JOIN (
    WITH params AS (
        SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 12 AS last_period
    ),
    first_version AS (
        SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
        FROM dim_member
    )
    SELECT fv.home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS new_members
    FROM first_version fv
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fv.version_no = 1
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    GROUP BY fv.home_store_id
) nm ON s.store_id = nm.home_store_id
WHERE s.store_id != 999
ORDER BY COALESCE(nm.new_members, 0) DESC, s.store_id;
